title: Why the Coin Stays: Inertia Explained Simply | PUC Physics Class 11
description:
Aarav puts a coin on a card over a glass and flicks the card away. The card flies off, but the coin drops straight into the glass. Why does it not go with the card? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Physics (NCERT Chapter 4, Laws of Motion) we learn what a force is and what inertia means.

We go from Aristotle's idea that motion needs a force to Galileo's smooth ramps on a live motion notebook: the ball climbs back to the same height, rolls farther as the second ramp gets flatter, and never stops when it is flat. A slow-mo replay of the coin trick shows the force acting on the card and not the coin, with a live graph. Two carts of 10 kg and 40 kg get the same push, so we see why mass is the measure of inertia. You also get two pause-and-think questions, a worked example, the exam trap about speed and inertia, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, JEE Main and NEET students.
